title: Delivery control
intro: Run local AI work, inspect evidence, and approve exact deliverables.
name: Name
inviteHelp: Share this single-use token privately with the intended team member.
empty: No tasks yet. Create a task with explicit acceptance criteria.
fixtureHelp: Choose a granted repository scope for an approved Git change, or a built-in specification for a protected Python result. Only the listed Python files are available to the coding agent.
approvalHelp: Read the current artifact before approving. Client and developer decisions require two separate authorized accounts.
deliveryHelp: Delivery binds the approved artifact and its evidence. Repository runs queue the approved file set for a Git commit at the pinned base. Inspect the receipt for the actual result.
inferenceReady: Local inference configured; a separate worker processes queued runs.
inferenceMissing: Local inference is not configured. Runs are unavailable.
runnerReady: Isolated runner configured. Each coding run must pass protected tests.
runnerMissing: Isolated coding runner is not configured. Coding runs are unavailable.
unavailable: The backend could not be reached. Start the API and open this page on its configured origin.
error: The request failed. Refresh the workspace before retrying.

errors.authentication_required: Your session expired. Sign in again.
errors.invalid_credentials: The email or password is incorrect.
errors.invalid_input: Check the form values and input lengths.
errors.stale_revision: This task changed. Refresh and review the current version.
errors.stale_approval: The artifact changed. Read the current version before approving.
errors.independent_approver_required: Another authorized person must approve the developer step.
errors.approvals_required: Client and developer approvals are required.
errors.permission_denied: Your workspace role cannot perform this action.
errors.rate_limit: Too many requests. Wait before retrying.
errors.csrf_failed: The session or origin changed. Reload this page and sign in again.
errors.run_already_active: A run is already queued or running for this task.
errors.release_in_progress: A release is queued, applying, or awaiting reconciliation. Resolve that release before changing this task.
errors.inference_not_configured: Configure local inference before submitting a run.
errors.runner_not_configured: Configure and qualify the isolated runner before coding runs.
errors.acceptance_criteria_required: Add acceptance criteria before running AI work.
errors.invitation_unavailable: This invitation is expired, invalid, or already used.
errors.account_unavailable: This account cannot be registered. Try signing in.
errors.repository_permission_revoked: Repository access changed. Ask the operator to review the workspace grant.
errors.source_context_limit: The selected source text exceeds the context limit. Use a smaller document.
errors.workspace_queue_limit: The workspace queue is full. Wait or cancel an existing run.
errors.source_permission_revoked: A source document was removed. Start a new task with current sources.
errors.registration_closed: Accounts are provisioned by the operator. Sign in with your assigned account.

sourceHelp: Add a brief as text or a small text file. Select documents to include in the next draft. Each document is an immutable workspace version; removing it blocks work that still depends on it.
executionStopped: Execution is stopped for this workspace.
